versions.content: Chronological reporting order of the DTCs located in the con- figured event memory Description: The diagnostic in AUTOSAR shall be able to handle the order of event occurrences (e.g. represented by a time stamp or odometer value). Rationale: Advanced fault analysis. AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Use Case: When processing 0x19 UDS job, DTCs are returned in the chronological order.
